map.《民法典》第188条，向人民法院请求保护民事权利的诉讼时效期间为三年: Article 188 of the Civil Code: the limitation period for requesting a people's court to protect civil rights is three years
map.如人身损害赔偿、出售质量不合格商品未声明、延付或拒付租金、寄存财物丢失或损毁等: Such as personal injury compensation, selling substandard goods without disclosure, delaying or refusing to pay rent, and loss of or damage to deposited property
map.自权利受到损害之日起超过二十年的，人民法院不予保护: No protection is granted once more than twenty years have passed since the date the right was infringed
map.权利人向义务人提出履行请求、义务人同意履行义务、权利人提起诉讼或申请仲裁等，时效: A demand for performance, the obligor's agreement to perform, or the right holder filing suit or applying for arbitration restarts the period
map.一般民事纠纷适用 3 年普通时效，从知道或应当知道权利受损及义务人之日算起。: Ordinary civil disputes follow the 3-year general period from the date the person knew or should have known of the infringement and of the obligor.
map.时效期间内起诉、请求、同意履行等中断，重新计算 3 年。: Filing suit, making a demand or agreeing to perform during the period interrupts it and restarts the 3 years.
map.自权利受损害之日起超过 20 年的，法院不予保护。: No court protection is granted once more than 20 years have passed since the date of damage.
map.权利受损害日 2023-03-15，时效自次日起算 3 年，届满 2026-03: Date of damage 2023-03-15: the 3 years start the next day and expire on 2026-03-15.
map.2024-09-01 起诉或书面催告，时效自该日重新计算 3 年，新届满 202: Filing suit or making a written demand on 2024-09-01 restarts the 3 years from that date, with a new expiry of 2027-09-01.
map.哪些请求权不适用 3 年？: Which claims do not follow the 3-year period?
map.如请求停止侵害、排除妨碍、消除危险、不动产物权返还等，适用特殊时效或不受时效限制: Claims to stop an infringement, remove an obstruction, eliminate a danger or recover real property follow special periods or are not subject to limitation, as the law provides.
map.20 年最长保护期怎么理解？: How should the 20-year maximum period be understood?
map.从权利受损害之日起算，超过 20 年法院不予保护，即便中间无中断；特殊情形可申请: It runs from the date of damage, and after 20 years no protection is granted even without interruption; in special cases an extension may be applied for and the court decides.
